title: BODBYN door
description: BODBYN door, gray, 12x40" A classic expression in soft grey with bevelled panels that create a traditional character with a warm and welcoming feel. BODBYN fronts are easy to keep clean thanks to the smooth lacquered surface. You can choose to mount the door on the right or left side.
features: Complete with UTRUSTA 110° hinge with built-in damper for kitchen, 2-pack, sold separately.
Requires a knob or a handle
May be completed with BODBYN cover panels, plinths and decorative strips in gray.
